entries.title: Complete the homepage and Genesis Programme launch experience
entries.objective: Finish and qualify the public website and Genesis Programme experience as the immediate user-facing entry points.
entry_gates: Current homepage and Genesis requirements reconciled with implementation.
Existing account, Genesis identity and financial rules reviewed.
exit_criteria: Approved requirements implemented without unsafe activation of disabled payment routes.
Desktop and responsive/browser checks pass to the supported verification scope.
Performance, accessibility, security and regression findings are recorded and remediated or explicitly blocked.
blockers: Canonical Navigation Protocol and plan template are not currently retrievable through the accessible project repositories; use documented development/audit fallback without claiming protocol conformance.
entries.notes: This remains the owner's immediate launch priority.

entries.title: Qualify market data sources, identities and methodology
entries.objective: Select legally and economically viable data providers and define reproducible market data contracts.
entry_gates: Identify required markets, metrics and coverage.
Review free-tier, commercial-use, caching and redistribution terms.
exit_criteria: Provider contract records include exact endpoints, data fields, quota, cost, licence and freshness.
Metric definitions and asset identity reconciliation are documented.
Fallback and unavailable-data behavior is tested.
entries.notes: No market provider is assumed approved merely because a free API exists.

entries.title: Prototype evidence-linked market investigations
entries.objective: Develop a narrowly scoped investigation workflow that connects market observations to evidence, hypotheses, counter-evidence and uncertainty.
entry_gates: Data-source contracts and legal use are qualified.
Initial asset/network perimeter defined.
Methodology separates observations, correlations and causal hypotheses.
exit_criteria: Historical case can be reproduced from preserved sources.
Competing hypotheses and counter-evidence are visible.
Independent tests measure source grounding and false-positive behaviour.
entries.notes: Do not present an AI-generated causal narrative without evidence.

entries.title: Build public shareable research and dashboard publishing
entries.objective: Allow users to publish selected research artifacts as useful, attributable and privacy-controlled public pages.
entry_gates: Research artifact schema and provenance exist.
Privacy, moderation and takedown rules are documented.
exit_criteria: User explicitly chooses public publication.
Private wallet and workspace data remain private unless separately disclosed.
Public page shows author, update time, sources and methodology.

evidence.reference: Owner direction dated 2026-11-20: consider sharing and adoption mechanisms during development.

entries.notes: Candidate implementation; public publishing is not approved merely by this roadmap entry.

entries.title: Build the personal intelligence workspace and read-only blockchain monitoring
entries.objective: Provide user-controlled watchlists, saved research, read-only monitoring and useful alerts.
entry_gates: Account identity, privacy and permission boundaries reconciled.
Initial supported chains and data contracts qualified.
exit_criteria: Saved objects have explicit owner and privacy scope.
Alerts have deduplication, freshness and delivery tests.
Read-only analytics do not imply custody or transaction authority.
entries.notes: Candidate; no portfolio or wallet data is public by default.

entries.title: Complete the first-party AstroCrown Community Network
entries.objective: Complete the first-party community product while preserving established identity, moderation and governance boundaries.
entry_gates: Draft Community requirements reconciled with owner decisions.
Moderation, appeals, ownership recovery and community settings policies resolved.
exit_criteria: Remaining approved member/profile, group and communication journeys are implemented.
Security, accessibility, load, backup and concurrency tests pass.
Constitutional governance rules are approved before binding elections activate.
blockers: GitHub PR #194 is draft and explicitly not production-ready; no production activation is inferred.
entries.notes: The first-party platform direction is approved; the current implementation is a development slice.

entries.title: Qualify public APIs, developer interfaces and AI-agent integration
entries.objective: Expose stable, provider-neutral AstroCrown intelligence contracts to developers and authorized agents.
entry_gates: Internal data and research schemas stabilized.
Authentication, quota, privacy and licensing requirements documented.
exit_criteria: Versioned API and machine-readable schemas are published.
Developer quickstart and reproducible examples pass tests.
Read-only and write-enabled scopes are separated.
entries.notes: No provider or MCP dependency is selected by this roadmap entry.

entries.title: Evaluate the Living Market Laboratory differentiation and feasibility
entries.objective: Determine whether a connected market model, autonomous investigation, counterfactual simulation, continuous re-evaluation and public evidence archive can form a defensible AstroCrown product.
entry_gates: Competitor capability matrix uses current official sources and real product tests where possible.
Initial market/system boundaries and evaluation tasks are specified.
exit_criteria: Existing competitors and adjacent research systems are mapped.
A smallest useful prototype has deterministic, reproducible evaluation tasks.
Uniqueness and superiority claims are limited to evidence that survives comparison.
entries.notes: Candidate concept only; no global uniqueness claim.

entries.title: Evaluate historical market reconstruction and time-capsule research
entries.objective: Determine whether original timestamped data and archived sources are sufficient to reconstruct what was knowable at past dates without look-ahead bias.
entry_gates: Historical source coverage and timestamp semantics documented.
Historical snapshot retention and correction policy defined.
exit_criteria: A dated reconstruction can be reproduced without post-cutoff evidence.
Missing or revised source material is clearly disclosed.
Look-ahead-bias tests reject future evidence.

entries.title: Operate the Product Development Memory and its quality gates
entries.objective: Preserve product intent and approved decisions in a compact repository source of truth, with deterministic checks against record corruption, garbage, duplicate entries, dangling references, loops and regressions.
entry_gates: Existing project documentation and authority boundaries inspected.
A timestamped backup exists before substantive modification.
exit_criteria: Strategy and structured registers are checked into the repository.
The validator and negative regression suite pass.
CI runs the exact commands against changed memory files.
The merge is confirmed on main and the Active Navigation Plan is closed.
blockers: Canonical NAVIGATION-PROTOCOL.md and NAVIGATION-PLAN-TEMPLATE.md are not retrievable from the currently accessible project repositories; the documented Development & Audit Convention and Active record fallback are being used without claiming canonical protocol conformance.
entries.notes: The structural gate does not replace substantive evidence review or owner approval.
